title: Kuaizi Launches K+ Ecosystem Plan with Thousands of Partners — Unique Capital Joins
summary: Post-COVID 2023 = year to push growth. Chopstick Tech (筷子科技) around Kuaizi SaaS + thousands of partners/clients + AIGC-focused investors including Unique Capital launch K+ Ecosystem Plan — open service network for industry growth.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight · February 12, 2023

Post-COVID 2023 = year to push growth. Chopstick Tech (筷子科技) around Kuaizi SaaS + thousands of partners/clients + AIGC-focused investors including Unique Capital launch K+ Ecosystem Plan — open service network for industry growth.

Why: firms need more partner links after pandemic damage; supply–demand info gaps + limited channels raise CAC; needs fragment so one vendor can’t cover all → one-stop demand rises.

What: focus growth; integrate supply/demand; link up/mid/downstream; more deals + traffic. Kuaizi opens own traffic; “Jiakuai” intelligent creative platform (2yrs) — image/video smart production, algo de-dupe, auto distribute, creator matrix, random assign — becoming industry-leading creative SaaS. Partners across creative, media, ecom, local-life invited into the network.

— END —
